checks.result: The exact implementation commit passed repository, runtime, architecture, agent-protocol, ADR, CI, format, lint, types, packaging, 63 foundation tests, and canonical backlog checks.

Schema, semantic state, stable hierarchy, lease ownership, dependency, gate, and all 13 committed evidence-reference integrity checks passed for 20 capabilities, 117 slices, 356 tasks, and 12 release gates.
Foundation repeated successfully; 19 security tests passed and the live supply-chain scan reported 31 packages, 30 license findings, and zero blocking findings.

evidence: READY calculation and claim now require completed task and slice dependencies, an open wave gate, the current campaign slice, a concrete matching profile/platform, and the active campaign owner lease; the campaign override flag was removed.
Task and campaign mutation commands verify owner identity and unexpired leases, while explicit owner-only renew commands recover expired task or campaign leases without enabling takeover.

Evidence attachment requires a repository-contained artifacts/evidence manifest naming current full HEAD, the claimed base SHA and branch, base ancestry, one non-empty record per criterion, only passing integer exit codes, and no unverified items; stored hashes are line-ending canonical and revalidated against task/commit identity.

Every mutation revalidates schema and semantic state, preserves the stable Capability/Slice/Task identity hierarchy, and performs an exclusive-lock compare-and-swap temporary-file replacement. Release gates reject reapproval and any incomplete preceding-wave task.

Nine focused workflow tests cover legal claim/review, task and slice dependency denials, activation gate denial, profile denial, campaign/task lease conflicts and renewal, exact-HEAD evidence, release-gate denial, stable-ID denial, invalid-state denial, stale-writer denial, and replace-failure recovery.
The focused schema plus workflow suites pass 19 tests, and the full foundation profile passes 63 tests at the exact implementation commit.

planning/README.md and the Codex tracking guide document the owned-lease transition sequence, exact-commit evidence contract, compare-and-swap behavior, and recovery commands; tools/README.md reflects the supported surface.

quality-scope.json governs the new workflow tests, lock markers are ignored, two legacy Windows-style evidence paths were canonically migrated, and no application, UI, architecture, dependency, or later-wave implementation scope changed.

reviewerDisposition.note: An independent reviewer must mutation-test authorization, transitions, exact-commit evidence, stable identity, concurrency/recovery behavior, and the criterion claims before approval.
